Each share of Fifth Third common stock outstanding on February 24, 2026 is entitled to one vote on all proposals at the meeting, either electronically or by proxy. Each share of outstanding Series A, Class B Preferred Stock on February 24, 2026 has 24 votes per share on all proposals at the meeting, either electronically or by proxy.
